title: How to stop managing media list spreadsheets on Mac for public relations specialists
metaTitle: Managing media list spreadsheets: PR workflow fixes for Mac
description: Stop wasting hours on manual media list spreadsheets. Learn how to optimize your PR workflow on Mac with better tools and smarter contact management.
intro: If you spend hours each week manually updating static files, you are likely losing time to the common trap of managing media list spreadsheets. This manual process creates bottlenecks that prevent you from focusing on actual relationship building and strategic outreach.
tldr: Manual spreadsheets are prone to errors and become outdated quickly.
Journalists change beats often, making static lists a liability.
Switching to a dedicated CRM or a contact manager saves hours of manual entry.
Lazur helps you dictate notes and search your contacts faster on Mac.

blocks.text: Why managing media list spreadsheets kills your productivity

The primary issue with managing media list spreadsheets is the lack of real time updates. When you keep a list in a static file, it is already obsolete the moment a journalist changes their beat or moves to a new publication. This leads to high bounce rates and wasted effort on outreach that never reaches the right person.
Common mistakes in PR contact management

items: Keeping duplicate contacts across multiple files.
Failing to record the last interaction date with a journalist.
Relying on memory instead of a centralized CRM system.
Ignoring the bounce rates on your email campaigns.

blocks.text: How to organize your media contacts on Mac

Instead of a spreadsheet, use a dedicated contact manager. Apps like BusyContacts or Cisdem ContactsMate allow you to tag contacts by industry, beat, and publication. These tools integrate directly with your Mac system contacts, making it easier to search for the right person when you are drafting a pitch in Gmail.
Use the search bar in your contact manager to filter by tags like 'Tech' or 'Lifestyle' to find relevant journalists in seconds.

blocks.text: Automating your PR outreach with Lazur

Lazur helps you move faster by keeping your focus on the screen. When you are inside your email app, hold the shortcut to ask about a specific contact. Lazur can surface information from your notes or help you draft a personalized pitch based on the journalist's recent work.
Best practices for maintaining clean data

Data hygiene is the unsung hero of PR success. Every time you receive an out of office reply or a bounce notification, update your contact list immediately. If you use a CRM, ensure that your team follows a consistent naming convention for tags and notes to avoid fragmentation.

faq.question: Is it safe to store media contacts in a CRM?
faq.answer: Yes, provided you follow your employer's data privacy policies. Always check if the CRM is compliant with your company's security standards.

faq.question: Can I use Excel for my PR lists?
faq.answer: You can, but it is not recommended for large lists. Dedicated PR software offers features like automatic updates and interaction tracking that spreadsheets lack.
